title: Financial Document Intelligence - RAG Field Extraction Spec
description: Module-wise catalogue of every field to extract from a company's annual report, expressed as RAG extraction queries. Each field is self-contained: `retrieval_query` (plus `keywords`) drives hybrid retrieval over the knowledge graph and embedding store to gather context; `extraction_prompt` instructs the LLM to answer the field from that context and return the value WITH its source citation. Only fields with rag_extractable=true are answered via retrieval; the rest are sourced by the pipeline.

pipeline: 1. For each rag_extractable field, embed retrieval_query and run hybrid (vector + graph + keyword) retrieval to gather candidate context.
2. Pass the retrieved context together with extraction_prompt to the LLM.
3. The LLM returns an answer conforming to output_contract (value + source + confidence).
4. Post-process: apply the field's `normalization`, validate against `data_type`/`enum_values`, and keep the source citation.
usage.routing: Fields where rag_extractable=false (metadata / external_lookup / computed / constant / not_extracted) are filled by the pipeline from the source named in `source_hint`, not by retrieval.

output_contract.value: The extracted value normalized per the field, or null if not found in context.

source.page: 1-based page number(s) the evidence came from
source.snippet: verbatim supporting text from the document
source.evidence_ids: ids of the retrieved graph nodes / embedding chunks used to answer

source_types.document_content: Answered via RAG - retrieved from the annual-report body (OCR text, tables, knowledge graph, embeddings).
source_types.metadata: Taken from the PDF filename / filesystem metadata, not RAG.
source_types.external_lookup: Supplied from an upstream database or external Excel; not present in the PDF body.
source_types.computed: Derived from other extracted fields or is a process/status value.
source_types.constant: Fixed / hardcoded value assigned by the pipeline.
source_types.not_extracted: Detection is defined but the field is not currently populated (WIP).
